months.windNote: Bura (NE) is the dominant wind on ~45% of days: cold, dry, gusty; jugo (SE) on ~21% brings rain. ~3 days/month with max wind >= 40 km/h.
Windiest month: bura ~39% and jugo ~34% of days; ~3.6 days with max wind >= 40 km/h.
Changeable: jugo ~36%, bura ~31%, first maestral (NW) days ~22%. Sea still cold (coldest in February).
Calmer: jugo ~34%, bura ~25%, maestral ~22%; ~1.4 days with max wind >= 40 km/h. Mild cycling weather.
Maestral (NW afternoon sea breeze) grows to ~30% of days; jugo ~28%. Showers still common.
Maestral dominant (~47% of days): steady NW breeze in the afternoon, calm mornings. Strong wind rare (~0.4 days).
Peak maestral (~57% of days) cools hot afternoons; driest, sunniest month.
Maestral ~47% of days; short bura spells (~26%) after thunderstorms, especially late August.
Mixed: bura ~33%, maestral ~28%, jugo ~24%. Sea still warmer than in June; heavy but short storms.
Bura ~39%, jugo ~32%; maestral fades. ~1.6 days with max wind >= 40 km/h. Sea warmer than the air at night.
Wettest month: jugo (~29%) brings rain, bura (~50%) clears it; ~2.8 strong-wind days.
Bura dominant (~49% of days): cold, clear, gusty; jugo ~22%.
